title: Dictate the probing
summary: Record the probing by voice: commands, active line and confirming what was dictated.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart with probing is the guide (a screening never is).

steps.title: Dictation
steps.details: It shows what was understood from each phrase and what is left to confirm.

steps.title: Dictate
steps.details: Turn the microphone on and speak: “38 lingual 3 2 4 bleeds distal”, “SS 23”, “gingival margin”, “lower arch”. Each phrase is applied when you finish it.

steps.title: Or type it
steps.details: The same command typed, then Enter. If a phrase is not understood, the AI rewrites it.

steps.title: Voice commands
steps.details: The full list, in Spanish and in English.

steps.title: Where it went
steps.details: What you dictated pulses on the chart and stays underlined in violet; if it is another arch, the view changes by itself.

steps.title: Confirm what was dictated
steps.details: Review it and tap Confirm (or say “confirm”). Discard reverts it. The chart cannot be signed with dictation pending.
